mission: Wedge observes a squadron departing a Corellian field; Syal/Lysa glimpsed among the pilots without being identified to the reader.
why_now: The squadron's launch is the first visible sign that the Corellian side is already militarizing.
opening_hook: Wedge at a hangar window watching a squadron of Corellian fighters pre-flight.
conflict: Wedge's detached observer posture against the personal resonance of seeing a particular pilot he can't quite place.
turning_point: Wedge almost recognizes a pilot (Syal/Lysa) and then files the half-recognition away.
closing_hook: The squadron launching; Wedge still at the window.
setting: Corellian squadron hangar observation deck, evening.
sensory_details: Ion-drive spool-up hum; hangar lighting; Wedge's hand on the window rail.
emotional_trajectory: Detached observation → unplaced recognition → filed-away disquiet.

stakes.interpersonal: The Antilles-family fracture that will eventually land.

action_beats: Squadron pre-flight visible through the window
notes: The Syal-identity hook is planted here, in an almost-recognition the reader will later decode.
